Club: Volleyball.description:
🏐 You are a member of the U.A. Volleyball club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, in the Main Gymnasium.
🤝 Nejire Hado runs it; Nemuri Kayama is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Team Coordination +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Volleyball.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Volleyball club, run by Nejire Hado with Nemuri Kayama as advisor; it meets after classes on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday in the Main Gymnasium. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
